news.title: 'Nothing can take my attention' - Ward on World Cup
news.lede: Ward's contract is due to expire in 2027. Republic of Ireland manager Carla Ward says that her focus is on reaching the Women's World Cup amid speculation linking her to a move back to the Women's Super League. The Republic have a chance to book a spot at next summer's finals in Brazil when they face a play-off against Kazakhstan before, if they progress, a two-legged final against either Belgium or Poland. Ward, who replaced Eileen Gleeson in January 2025, has been linked with the vacant post at her former club Aston Villa but she insists leading the Republic of Ireland to the World Cup is her primary ambition.

news.title: Messi debunks the conspiracy theories about the World Cup final: "Nothing strange happened, it's reality"
news.lede: it wasn't in the script, but Leo Messi surprised everyone by speaking candidly about what happened in the last World Cup. The crushing defeat against Spain in the grand final gave rise in his country to all kinds of speculation. The brief rallying cry in the dressing room, the players' faces out on the pitch, the poor performance on display... all of it generated countless theories, each more twisted than the last. Well, Leo took advantage of the day of his farewell to put all those thoughts to rest.

news.title: England Women in World Cup 2027 play-offs: Lionesses have obligation to prove themselves after Spain disappointment
news.lede: When England were consigned to the World Cup play-offs back in June, it felt like a massive step backwards. How were the European champions not a shoo-in for the next major tournament in the international calendar? The Lionesses only missed out by a whisker, finishing their qualifying campaign with 15 points from a possible 18. But it's difficult to overlook how we got here.

news.title: Messi retires from international football as Argentina defeats Benin in friendly match
news.lede: Lionel Messi retired from international football on Tuesday (October 6, 2026), scoring a goal and providing two assists as Argentina defeated Benin 3-0 in a friendly international. Messi, playing in his record-extending 208th international, provided the assist for the opening goal scored by veteran Nicolas Otamendi, with Nico Paz also scoring. Messi’s 71st minute penalty was his record-extending 126th international goal. The 39-year-old, widely regarded as the greatest player in football history, had announced his decision to retire in August following Argentina’s World Cup defeat to Spain.

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal star breaks silence over national team walkout in statement
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo has broken his silence over his Portugal walkout in a lengthy statement in which he says he is not retiring from the national team. The 41-year-old, whose actions had raised doubts over his international future, accused Portugal's new head coach Jorge Jesus of broken promises in a near 2,000-word statement to his 679 million Instagram followers. You can read the statement in full at the bottom of this article. Addressing the uncertainty over his Portugal future, the Al Nassr forward said: "If I am physically well, playing for my club, with goals I hope, after serving the suspension that may be applied to me, I will be available, as I have always been until today, to compete and win for our national team."

news.title: England have put World Cup disappointment behind them, says Tuchel
news.lede: Soccer Football - Nations League - England Press Conference - Tottenham Hotspur Training Ground, London, Britain - October 5, 2026 England manager Thomas Tuchel during the press conference John Walton/Pool via REUTERS. Oct 7 - England have moved on from their World Cup semi-final disappointment and taken an important step forward with their performances in the Nations League, manager Thomas Tuchel said. After suffering a 3-2 defeat by world champions Spain in their Nations League opener, England responded with home and away wins over the Czech Republic and a 7-0 thrashing of Croatia, scoring 14 goals in their opening four matches.

news.title: Messi’s Legendary Argentina Legacy: A Career Beyond Legendary
news.lede: Lionel Messi’s legacy with Argentina stands as one of the greatest achievements in international football history. The Argentine superstar has produced extraordinary numbers and collected virtually every major honour available to him at international level. 16 World Cup Man of the Match awards. 1 Copa América Best Young Player award.
